protocol_status: chosen by Yash with assistant on 2026-10-27; baseline must use these same choices for comparison
data_source: Stan compilation provided by Advay, frozen split v1
observation_convention: States directly in thousands of pelts; no fitted observation-scale factor; annual totals approximated as point samples
note: Exploratory positive box bounds in effective pelt units, not measured ecological ranges. No coexistence constraint and no e<=1 constraint. Every rate is inferred; none of the synthetic fixed constants is carried over. Starting guesses are optimization choices. Bounds expansion is predeclared before any held-out scoring; all runs and sensitivity variants will be retained.
